title: RateCard
description: One provider price with its free allowance, in the provider's real billing unit, with effective dates and where it was checked (roadmap WS-Z3 task 5). v1.1 adds optional `side` (supply|retail), `version` and `effective_to`; existing documents stay valid. Changed only by review; never written by an AI on its own.

side.description: Whether this card prices what OpenVibe pays (supply) or what the customer pays (retail).

version.description: Immutable version of this card; settlements reference it so historical prices survive updates.

metric.description: e.g. queue-operation-64kb, request, gib-delivered, message, gb-month, class-a-op

effective_to.description: Inclusive end date; null or absent means open-ended.
